brief: public static BasicContentHandlerFactory newInstance(HANDLER_TYPE type, ParseContext context){}
method_comment:
* Creates a new BasicContentHandlerFactory configured from OutputLimits in the ParseContext. *

* If OutputLimits is present in the context, the factory will be configured with those * limits (writeLimit, throwOnWriteLimit). Otherwise, default values are used. * * @param type the handler type * @param context the ParseContext (required if throwOnWriteLimit is false) * @return a configured BasicContentHandlerFactory
